steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Composites: matrix + reinforcement. CFRP: carbon fibres in epoxy - exceptional strength-to-weight, F1 cars, aircraft. GFRP (fibreglass): glass fibres in polyester resin - lighter than metals, corrosion resistant.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Concrete: aggregate + cement + water - excellent compressive strength, reinforced with steel rebar for tensile strength.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Thermochromic materials: change colour at specific temperatures - baby spoons, mood rings, kettles, bath plugs.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Shape-memory alloys (SMA): Nitinol (nickel-titanium) - deformed at room temperature, returns to original shape when heated. Medical stents, orthodontic wires.

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: Always define composite = matrix + reinforcement and name both parts Smart materials respond to a STIMULUS - always identify it (heat, light, stress, pH) Distinguish composites (physical combination) from alloys (metallic bonding)
